## 1 INSTALLATION

1. Install prerequisite software and required packages (see [instruction](https://github.com/kwanjeeraw/MMFramework)).
2. Download MMFramework from [here](https://github.com/kwanjeeraw/MMFramework/blob/main/MMFramework.zip)
3. Unzip the downloaded MMFramework.zip file to your desired directory.

## 2 RUNNING FRAMEWORK
1. Open a terminal:
* Windows: Command Prompt or PowerShell
* macOS / Linux: Terminal
2. Open R or RStudio.
3. Run the framework script step-by-step as the following section.

## 3 MMFramework
1. A schematic overview of the analysis workflow is shown in Figure S1.

![**Figure 1.** Overview of the analysis workflow](Fig1.png)

*2.1 Input data*
  The framework requires three input data types:
  * Clinical data
  * Metabolomics data
  * Integrated data (a concatenated table of clinical and metabolomics data)
  A dataframe of patient metadata and metabolite profiles as shown in Table 2.

```{r,echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
dt = read.csv(file = "../LN/input_LN.csv", row.names = FALSE)
kable(dt) %>%
  kable_styling(c("striped", "bordered"), full_width = F) %>%
  column_spec(1:9, bold = T, background = '#FFCCCC') %>%
  column_spec(9, border_right = T) %>%
  column_spec(10:14, background = '#CCE5FF')
```

**Table 2**. Part of adipose tissue data set is illustrated including patient metadata (red) and metabolite profiles (blue).

######################## RUN MODELS ########################
##### ML models #####
#PLS-DA
Rscript Pls_run.R --wkpath /Users/mint/Documents/siri/nonImage/production/MMFramework/ \
--proc auto \
--input LN/input_LN.csv \
--outpath LN/metabolomics \
--train LN/TrainList_biclass.txt \
--test LN/TestList_biclass.txt

#RF
Rscript Rf_run.R --wkpath /Users/mint/Documents/siri/nonImage/production/MMFramework/ \
--proc log2 \
--input LN/input_LN.csv \
--outpath LN/metabolomics \
--train LN/TrainList_biclass.txt \
--test LN/TestList_biclass.txt

##### DL models ##### 
#Grad-CAM
python3 Gradcam_run.py --wkpath /Users/mint/Documents/siri/nonImage/production/MMFramework/ \
--proc log2 \
--input LN/input_LN.csv \
--outpath LN/metabolomics \
--train LN/TrainList_biclass.txt \
--test LN/TestList_biclass.txt \
--epoch 200 \
--batch 32

#SHAP
python3 Shap_run.py --wkpath /Users/mint/Documents/siri/nonImage/production/MMFramework/ \
--proc log2 \
--input LN/input_LN.csv \
--outpath LN/metabolomics \
--train LN/TrainList_biclass.txt \
--test LN/TestList_biclass.txt \
--epoch 200 \
--batch 32
